nr1196.summary: Moscow tells the Berlin trade office to inform Fedorovskii that an order has gone to Litvinov to transfer fifty thousand gold rubles to Berlin, to pay for the orders of the Scientific-Technical Department.
nr1196.en:
Inform Fedorovskii, colon: at the same time an order has been given to Litvinov for a transfer to Berlin in payment of the
orders of the Scientific-Technical Department, countervalue fifty thousand gold rubles.

snip.cap: Lejava to Stomoniakov via Kopp, 5 April 1921
snip.credit: NARA RG 59, 861.00, M316 roll 41, frame 0787, via the National Archives Catalog
